payload.rationale_summary: The rating continues to reflect Bharat Manufacturing's established market position in precision engineering, diversified revenue base across auto, defence and industrial segments, healthy operating margins (24.2% EBITDA), and comfortable leverage (Debt/Equity 1.03x). Rating stability supported by order book of ~2.5x FY2024 revenue and improving working capital cycle. The outlook is stable.
key_rating_drivers: Established market position with 15+ years track record
Diversified revenue across 3 segments reducing concentration risk
Healthy EBITDA margin at 24.2% (FY2024), above industry median
Adequate liquidity with undrawn credit lines of ₹45 Cr

rating_sensitivity.upgrade: Sustained revenue growth >15% with EBITDA margin >25% and D/E <0.8x
rating_sensitivity.downgrade: Revenue decline >10% or EBITDA margin <18% or D/E >1.5x
